boundary: No transaction: RSDServlet.doGet resolves the weblog (WeblogRequest.getWeblog) via JPAWeblogManagerImpl.getWeblogByHandle; every read goes through JPAPersistenceStrategy.getEntityManager(false), no transaction opens, each read auto-commits. The model passed to rsd.vm (website, absBaseURL) is populated directly (no ModelLoader), and the template only reads plain getters ($website.handle), no further DB access.
